name: cloud-infrastructure
title: Cloud infrastructure and hosting
summary: Choose where the product runs and build it: hosting model, container images for a Rust binary, Kubernetes, serverless and WASM edge runtimes, cloud networking, IAM, infrastructure as code and cost control.
useWhen: Where should I host this: a PaaS, serverless, a VPS, containers or Kubernetes?
Write or shrink a Dockerfile, or set up Docker Compose for local development
Set up AWS, GCP or Azure accounts, IAM roles and permissions properly
Write Terraform or OpenTofu for our infrastructure
Design the VPC, subnets and private access to the database
My cloud bill jumped and I need to find out why and cut it
Serverless functions are slow to start or exhausting the database
A pod is stuck Pending or crash-looping in Kubernetes
Should this code run at the edge or next to the database?
Run part of the app on Cloudflare Workers with workers-rs, or on AWS Lambda

notFor.topic: CI pipelines, deploy strategies, rollbacks and feature flags
Shell access, systemd, host hardening, instance and disk sizing, and container internals on one machine
